facts.fact: The MainOne data centre in Abidjan, built beside the cable landing station, was reported in service with the cable branch in December 2019, offering carrier-neutral colocation rack space (100 racks, up to 8 kW per rack).
MainOne states its Abidjan data centre is Tier III-compliant (operator statement; no Uptime Institute or TIA-942 certification is cited), in service December 2019.
